design: A sinister yet stylized cartoon giant shadow spider, low broad plum-black chitin body with angular shell plates, small violet markings, cluster of sharp amber eyes, two short curved ivory fangs, exactly EIGHT legs in FOUR PAIRS attached to its thorax; far-side legs may be partly occluded in the same three-quarter view. One complete connected spider per cell with all legs and abdomen unclipped, generous padding.
